name: Gouda Studios Agent Tools
description: Agent-payable public records data tools (SAM.gov, SEC EDGAR, USAspending, GLEIF) via Apify's hosted MCP server.

tools.name: gouda_studios/sam-gov-opportunities-feed
tools.description: Federal contract opportunities from SAM.gov with NAICS, PSC, set-aside, place of performance, response deadline and days left, contracting contacts, and a new-only monitoring mode. No API key needed.

tools.name: gouda_studios/sec-edgar-filings-feed
tools.description: New SEC EDGAR filings by ticker, CIK or form type from the official SEC APIs: form, filing date, 8-K items, company, SIC and direct document links. Change-only monitoring mode.

tools.name: gouda_studios/usaspending-awards-search
tools.description: Search U.S. federal contract and grant awards from the official USAspending.gov API by keyword, recipient, agency, NAICS, state, date and amount. Award amount, recipient UEI, agency and links.

tools.name: gouda_studios/gleif-company-lei-lookup
tools.description: Verify companies worldwide from the official GLEIF LEI API: legal name, status, jurisdiction, registration number, legal and HQ address, direct and ultimate parent. KYB and enrichment for 2.9M+ entities.
